name: dn-countryname-wrong-length-invalid
description: permittedSubtrees directoryName is C=US,O=Example. The leaf's countryName is 'USA' (three letters). X.520 fixes countryName to a 2-letter PrintableString, so the leaf's attribute is malformed; even setting that aside, 'USA' is not equal to 'US' under RFC 5280 7.1 comparison, so the leaf is outside the permitted subtree. The case is a probe against constraint comparators that do `strncmp(constraint, leaf, 2)` or otherwise accept length-mismatched country codes as prefixes.
notes: Built via the per-AVA `validate: false` flag so cryptography emits the 3-octet PrintableString that the X.520 length check would otherwise reject.
